highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and fixes two native use-after-free leaks.
highlights_body: Alongside the Skia m152 bump, this preview adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan/Metal/Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixes native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap subsetting.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: The bundled engine is bumped to Chrome milestone m152, with follow-up merges of upstream m151/m152 stability fixes.
Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Vulkan test coverage on Android/Linux.
Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works consistently across GPU backends.

bullets.lead: FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server now resolves fonts through FreeType instead of relying on unavailable platform font APIs.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free fixes in SKRegion and SKPixmap
bullets.detail: Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, and a similar bug in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the source pixel buffer.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on SKImage.Create failure
bullets.detail: Fixes a native memory leak that occurred when SKImage.Create's raster failure path left an allocated CoTaskMem pixel buffer undisposed.

bullets.lead: Containerized test legs and slnx solution format
bullets.detail: Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl and Nano Server containerized test coverage, and converts all .sln solutions to the newer .slnx format.
Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of per invocation.

bullets.lead: Faster and more deterministic binding generation
bullets.detail: Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check for lower per-call overhead, optimizes SKData.SaveTo to avoid a double buffer copy, and makes generated bindings deterministic across build platforms.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC environment once per native build on Windows
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated Skia to milestone m152, added Graphite GPU backend bindings and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, introduced backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixed use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap.

harfbuzz_summary: No functional HarfBuzzSharp binding changes; the touched files were solution-format conversion and CI test-leg infrastructure work.
